matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the placement of the indicator function in Equation 1 of the objective function, which creates an inconsistency with the BC term during warm-up. Neither finding addresses this equation or the warm-up/BC term inconsistency; both findings focus on surrogate gradient equations in Section 8.1.

GT2 concerns the undefined derivative variable r′_{t−i} in Equation 7 of the adaptive slope scheduler. Neither finding addresses this equation or the adaptive scheduling mechanism; both findings focus on surrogate gradient formulations in the supplementary materials.

GT3 concerns the soft-reset mechanism in Equation 4, specifically the inconsistency between the mathematical formulation and the biological interpretation of membrane potential. Neither finding addresses the spiking neuron dynamics or reset mechanism; both focus on surrogate gradient equations.

This identifies an inconsistency between the appendix and main text regarding gradient magnitude bias, which is not among the ground truth defects.
